build_annotation_tree: build an Annotation parse tree from a seqlogical string with intent and slot labels
validate_annotation_tree: validate an Annotation tree structure checking correct nesting of intents, slots, and tokens
build_tree_from_actions: build a parse tree incrementally using TreeBuilder with SHIFT, REDUCE, and nonterminal actions
convert_tree_to_actions: convert an Annotation tree into a list of SHIFT and REDUCE actions for sequence modeling
list_actions_from_indices: convert action indices and vocabulary into a list of action-label tuples for decoding
